notes: «وَ بِهَذَا الْإِسْنَادِ» takes over prev1's chain up to «سُلَیْمَانَ بْنِ عُمَرَ» as inherited items (the back-reference itself is not written); the three co-transmitters of prev1 stand in one level
prev1 continues «عَنْ مُهَاجِرِ بْنِ الْحَسَنِ عَنْ زَیْدِ بْنِ أَرْقَمَ»: not taken, because this text names its own transmitter «زيد بن رافع» after Sulayman
the saying is Hudhayfa's, as Zir heard him («سَمِعْتُ حُذَیْفَهَ یَقُولُ»)
